entities.name: Rotapan
entities.description: A small half-orc and overking of Wyrvil in 3050 AR who built a palace of bones and was swept away by a flood.

entities.name: Wyrvil
entities.description: The orcish realm ruled by Rotapan.

entities.name: Silver Sea
entities.description: An inland sea next to Rotapan's realm.

entities.name: Chelydrus
entities.description: A giant sea snake or water drake in the Silver Sea worshipped by Rotapan.

entities.name: Cheyne
entities.description: Granted an audience with Rotapan and helped steal his scepter.

entities.name: Claria
entities.description: Granted an audience with Rotapan and helped steal his scepter.

entities.name: Ogwater Rifkin
entities.description: A songmage who helped steal the scepter and cast a spell that melted the ice of Drufalden's kingdom.

entities.name: Drufalden
entities.description: Ruler of a cold kingdom whose ice Ogwater melted.

entities.name: River Kingdom of selkies
entities.description: A kingdom whose king Rotapan held captive.

events.summary: Rotapan becomes underking and then overthrows the overking to become one himself.
events.quote: eventually becoming underking, and then overthrowing the overking and becoming one himself

events.summary: Rotapan kills all would-be usurpers, including Carsh, Clutch, Glom, Jepli, Puffer, Rafek, Rasper and Sawsa.
events.quote: killing all his would-be usurpers and earning great respect among his underlings

events.summary: Cheyne, Claria and Ogwater Rifkin distract Rotapan, steal the scepter holding the magical gem and escape across the Silver Sea.
events.quote: distracted Rotapan long enough to steal the scepter holding the magical gem

events.summary: Ogwater melts the ice of Drufalden's kingdom, causing a flood that sweeps away Rotapan and his bone palace.
events.quote: Rotapan and the remains of his bone palace were swept away by the rush of water

relations.note: They stole his scepter and he pursued them.

relations.quote: Cheyne , Claria , and Ogwater Rifkin were granted an audience
